independent_verification.aa_semantic_scope: Same point, seed, policy, recovered scalar, recorded outcome and preparation charges; not a full intermediate-state trace
independent_verification.floating_binding_tolerance: 8*f64_epsilon*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)); less than0.004ns at2100s cap in ms units; integer phase/residual identities exact
independent_verification.no_child_usage_policy: Null CPU/RSS/exit fields accepted only for LAUNCH_FAILED with no semantic answers; these processes remain incomplete and can never PASS
not_established: Full IC rank and factor-log transcript
Exact five-phase IC online conformance: residual and input-validation mismatch retained
independent_verification.reserialization_copy_binding_policy: Only four authenticated observation-copy comparisons allow at most one adjacent decoded finite-f64 step at explicitly allowlisted diagnostic metadata paths. Both tokens must have valid JSON float grammar. All integer/u128, string, key, array, identity, scalar, witness, seed, counter, hash, protocol, configuration, matrix and A/A comparisons remain exact. Existing eight-epsilon arithmetic-derived checks are unchanged.
independent_verification.verification_cost_boundary: This external C++ audit is outside all solver process and online intervals; its resource receipt is reported separately. Both methods already charge built-in group verification.

limitations: Supplemental descriptive fields only; no new primary estimator, bootstrap, optimization or ledger admission.
Phase boundaries differ across IC and rho. IC phase residual cannot be reassigned to a particular algorithm stage.
Process peak RSS is not per-target peak memory; it is not summed as simultaneously required memory.
All signed timing residuals are retained. Producer process wall and supervisor whole-process wall have different boundaries.
Zero process timeouts does not imply zero internal capped walks/restarts. Ten A/A rows remain separate from104 main rho answers.
